title: Scalar linearity of ordinary unbounded ringed pro-etale operations
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $u:U\to V$ a morphism of schemes with small pro-etale sites, and $R_U,R_V$ sheaves of commutative rings on those sites, equipped with ring maps $A\to\Gamma(W,R_W)$ for $W=U,V$ (thus giving compatible sectionwise $A$-actions). Suppose the specified coefficient identification $c:u^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_U$ respects the $A$-algebra structures. Use the ordinary unbounded module derived categories $D(R_W)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_W))$ and the canonical adjoint operations $L_u=Lu^*$, $D_u=Ru_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Give these categories the $A$-linear structures induced by their module-sheaf Hom groups and localization [def-weil-linear-category, lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. Then $L_u$ and $D_u$ are additive $A$-linear functors [def-weil-linear-functor]: for either functor $F$, parallel derived morphisms $s,t$ and $a\in A$, one has $F(s+t)=F(s)+F(t)$ and $F(as)=aF(s)$. No boundedness, completeness or constructibility condition is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09MK, definition-functor-linear-categories; agent-supplied scalar-linearity refinement of ordinary ringed operations, using derived.tex Tag 070I, lemma-K-injective. Neither tag alone states this combined refinement.

proof.text: Write $P=u^*$ and $G=u_*$ for the underived module functors of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For an object $W$ of the site of $V$, put $W_U=U\times_V W$. The scalar $a\in A$ acts on $(GM)(W)=M(W_U)$ through the image of $a$ under $A\to R_V(W)\to R_U(W_U)$. The $A$-compatibility of $c$ identifies this image with the restriction to $W_U$ of the specified global section of $R_U$. Thus, for parallel module-sheaf maps $h,k:M\to N$, the equalities $G(h+k)_W=h_{W_U}+k_{W_U}$ and $G(ah)_W=a h_{W_U}$ hold sectionwise. They commute with restrictions, giving equalities of sheaf maps. In each module-sheaf category the sum and scalar action on Hom are sectionwise; the module laws and bilinearity of composition are checked on sections. These are the $A$-linear category structures of [def-weil-linear-category]. Consequently $G$ is additive and $A$-linear.

source.place: Tag 03D3, lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules, module adjunction and unit formula; elementary scalar refinement using dga.tex Tag 09MK, definition-functor-linear-categories.

proof.text: Use the underived module adjunction $P\dashv G$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with unit $\eta$. For fixed module sheaves $M,N$ on $V$, its bijection $\Phi:\operatorname{Hom}(PM,PN)\to\operatorname{Hom}(M,GPN)$ is $h\mapsto G(h)\circ\eta_M$. Step 1 and bilinearity of composition [def-weil-linear-category] show directly that $\Phi(h+k)=\Phi(h)+\Phi(k)$ and $\Phi(ah)=a\Phi(h)$. Naturality of $\eta$ gives $\Phi(Ps)=\eta_N\circ s$ for each $s:M\to N$. Therefore $\Phi(P(s+t))=\eta_N\circ(s+t)=\Phi(Ps+Pt)$ and $\Phi(P(as))=\eta_N\circ(as)=\Phi(aPs)$. Injectivity of $\Phi$ proves that $P$ is additive and $A$-linear. This uses only the given ordinary adjunction, without presupposing that its Hom bijection is linear.

source.place: Tag 03D3, lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules, module adjunction and unit formula; elementary scalar refinement using dga.tex Tag 09MK, definition-functor-linear-categories.

proof.text: The identified-coefficient construction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] makes $P$ exact and defines $L_u=Lu^*$ by applying $P$ termwise and passing to the ordinary unbounded derived categories. In particular $P$ is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits; the coefficient isomorphism, rather than any flatness hypothesis on $u$ as a scheme morphism, is what supplies exactness here. The source and target have precisely the induced $A$-linear derived structures of [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. Apply [lem-cbc-exact-linear-derived-functor] with $R=A$, $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R_V)$, $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}(R_U)$ and $F=P$, using step 2 for linearity. It gives $L_u(s+t)=L_u(s)+L_u(t)$ and $L_u(as)=aL_u(s)$ on all derived morphisms.

source.place: Tag 04JC, lemma-flat-pullback-exact, identified-coefficient exactness; Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean:27-43,120-125, CategoryTheory.Functor.instLinearDerivedCategoryMapDerivedCategory. Agent refinement of Stacks Tag 09MK.

proof.text: Finally use the ordinary unbounded derived adjunction $L_u\dashv D_u$ stated in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and let $\epsilon:L_uD_u\to\mathrm{id}$ be its counit. For fixed $X,Y\in D(R_U)$ its bijection $\Psi:\operatorname{Hom}(D_uX,D_uY)\to\operatorname{Hom}(L_uD_uX,Y)$ sends $h$ to $\epsilon_Y\circ L_u(h)$. By step 3 and bilinear composition [def-weil-linear-category], $\Psi$ preserves addition and $A$-scalars. Counit naturality gives $\Psi(D_u(s))=s\circ\epsilon_X$ for $s:X\to Y$. Consequently $\Psi(D_u(s+t))=(s+t)\circ\epsilon_X=\Psi(D_u(s)+D_u(t))$ and $\Psi(D_u(as))=(as)\circ\epsilon_X=\Psi(aD_u(s))$. Injectivity proves both required identities for $D_u$. Together with step 3 these are exactly additive $A$-linearity [def-weil-linear-functor]. Every Hom and adjunction used is in the ordinary unbounded categories; no boundedness, completeness or constructibility has been introduced.

lean.statement: theorem proEtaleRingDerivedOperations_scalarLinearity (A : Type v) [CommRing A] {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) (RV : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (RU : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RV ≅ RU) (aV : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (RV.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (aU : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (RU.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (hc : ∀ (a : A) (W : V.ProEt), (proEtaleRingDirectImageMap f RV RU c).hom.app (op W) ((aV a).val (op W)) = (aU a).val (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj W))) : ∃ (lU : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules U RU)) (lV : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules V RV)), (fun [_iU : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules U RU)] [_iV : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules V RV)] ↦ (∀ (M N : proEtaleRingModules U RU) (h : M ⟶ N) (a : A) (W : U.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj W), (a • h).val.app W x = (aU a).val W • h.val.app W x) ∧ (∀ (M N : proEtaleRingModules V RV) (h : M ⟶ N) (a : A) (W : V.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj W), (a • h).val.app W x = (aV a).val W • h.val.app W x) ∧ (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f RV RU c).Additive ∧ Functor.Linear A (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f RV RU c) ∧ (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f RV RU c).Additive ∧ Functor.Linear A (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f RV RU c)) (_iU := lU) (_iV := lV)
